statement: Every reader of a services, nodes or replica_operations row under src/node reads the decoded object from the table's decoder module (a full-row decode or a named projection declared beside the query), so raw column reads outside the decoders in the node group reach zero, the readStateField reads the state-read-named-defaults quest left on these tables there become decoded named states, and the row_field_alias_reads cap tightens by the number of alias reads removed; behaviour is unchanged.

constraints.statement: Only the table's decoder reads its raw column names. A consumer that still does is a violation the detector reports, not an allowed exception.
The decoder shapes the row it was given. It never fetches, caches or defaults a value the row lacks; an absent column is a typed refusal (R05, R07).
The row_field_alias_reads baseline is lowered in the same change by the number of alias reads removed, starting from the value the stream holds at the seal.
Consumers read the same values under their decoded names; every expectation change in an existing test is justified against HEAD behaviour with a production-shaped fixture.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
